title: Soul Feast #78: How Pain, Loss & Jesus Transformed My View of Resurrection – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE


In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores resurrection through the lens of multisensory perception – not as religious doctrine, but as a living symbol of what is happening to billions of souls right now. Drawing on his own transformative experiences, including the Soul’s transition of his beloved Spiritual Partner, Linda, and the awakening that followed,
Gary reveals how resurrection is not a miraculous event reserved for the divine. Instead, it is a journey available to every Soul willing to move through pain consciously and make the Responsible Choice to choose love on the other side.

For Gary, the word “resurrection” had once belonged to Christianity – distant and beyond his reach. But when he sat with its true meaning – to restore – his internal landscape shifted. The crucifixion, he explains, is a map: the horizontal path represents a life of attempting to change circumstances without changing the self, while the vertical path is the path of spiritual evolution, where the Soul wakes up to something larger than the personality – its own Immortal nature. Resurrection, Gary says, is that waking. It is the before and the after – the moment a Soul, broken open by the curriculum of the Earth School, is restored to who they truly are.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:00) — Two Worlds, One Choice: Gary opens with an invitation to choose between the new multisensory consciousness – gratitude, contentment, and awe – and the old world of external power defined by anger, worry, and despair.

(03:05) — Compadre: Gary revisits his unexpected encounter with Jesus, who met him not as a distant deity but as a Spiritual Partner and equal who said simply, “I’m your compadre” – a moment that made the Responsible Choice to ever close his heart again unthinkable.

(06:06) — What Does Resurrection Actually Mean?: Gary unpacks the word restore and how that single definition reframes the Earth School curriculum. There is a before and an after, and what comes after is the restoration of the personality to the frequency of the Soul.

(09:01) — The Night He Wanted to Die: Gary shares the raw reality of Linda’s Soul’s transition and the morning-after realization that arrived as a permanent truth: the Soul’s intention for his remaining time is simply to love people.

(12:01) — Souls in the Earth School: Gary illuminates what resurrection symbolizes on a cosmic scale – the Soul returning home, and the consciousness that carries forward the consequences of every Responsible Choice made in this life.

(18:00) — What’s Yours?: Returning to Jesus as a model of conscious choice, Gary asks the question that anchors the creation of Authentic Power: faced with excruciating pain, Jesus chose love and forgiveness. In every moment, that same choice is available to each of us.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think of a moment when pain cracked you open – when something you didn’t think you could survive actually changed you. Not break you. Changed you. Was there a before and an after? Was there something in you that was restored – not created new, but returned? What would it mean to stop waiting for a dramatic resurrection and recognize that every time you choose love over fear, something in you rises? What small resurrection is available to you right now, in this moment, in this choice?
